explainer_content.short_definition: Hip-hop's first recorded era: DJ breaks, MC routines, electro beats, party culture, and early social rap.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Old-school hip-hop grew from Bronx block parties and DJ practices into records that introduced rap to national and global audiences.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It established the core grammar of MC, DJ, breakbeat, crew identity, and street reportage that later rap styles build on.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The energy is direct, rhythmic, and functional: move the party, display skill, and make the beat speak.
